first_hop_successor.proof_policy: For the two blob-pinned successor surfaces, each predecessor proof literal must remain present but its historical occurrence count is not transferred. The exact successor blob, strict identity declarations and source boundaries jointly attest the new surface. All sixteen unchanged first-hop surfaces retain predecessor normalized hash, length and exact proof-count enforcement.
first_hop_successor.non_transfer: This successor exception does not admit a new identity, alter the predecessor denominator, apply a caret to a shorthand or pending object, transfer a personal act to another date, or establish knowledge, wrongdoing or liability.

invariants: No new identity is created merely to repair an occurrence of an existing confirmed identity.
The generic Auren perimeter PD-SP-O-0046 remains distinct from exact AUREN REESTRUCTURACIONES SLP PD-SP-O-0070.
A source quotation or transcript is not silently rewritten to add a caret.
A pending or suspended identity must never be rendered as CARET_CONFIRMED.
Spanish and English controlled surfaces remain equivalent in identity state and source boundary.
The historical 18-route first-hop snapshot remains immutable; intentional changes require a separately pinned successor surface.
A branch or pull request is not live publication; a deployment is not live verification without route readback.
No repository control authorises email, filing, service, external contact or publication of restricted material.
